findings.summary: IMPL-004 depends on IMPL-002 and IMPL-003, but this is an ordering constraint rather than a true code dependency
findings.recommendation: Consider changing IMPL-004 depends_on to [IMPL-001] only, enabling earlier start. Or document this as an intentional ordering constraint (P0 before P1). Current approach is valid for phased execution.

findings.summary: F-004 SHOULD requirement for provider-config-validator.ts tests is not included in IMPL-004 deliverables
findings.recommendation: Add provider-config-validator.test.ts as a SHOULD-have file in IMPL-004, or explicitly note it as deferred to N+1

findings.summary: No convergence criteria explicitly verify the 'test execution < 30 seconds' constraint from planning notes
findings.recommendation: Add timing assertion to IMPL-001 convergence verification: measure total test suite runtime after each phase

findings.summary: IMPL-002 (8-10 days) and IMPL-003 (6-8 days) effort estimates may be conservative for extending/creating test files with shared infrastructure
findings.recommendation: These are inherited from brainstorm feature specs and reflect cautious estimates. Keep as-is — overestimation is safer than underestimation.
